description.value:
This pursuit unlocks discoveries shaped by your study of the political world. Each time you gain a new discovery, you may take one of the following instead, listed here alphabetically.

Charming Feint. Allies within the range of your Motivating Diplomat also add half your Critical Analysis ability modifier to their damage rolls.

Demanding Leader (5th level required). Every maneuver you use reaches 10 feet farther; a maneuver normally requiring touch instead has a 10-foot range.

Dominating Presence (15th level required). As a bonus action, you can direct a humanoid that understands you and is charmed or frightened by you, forcing it to attempt a Wisdom saving throw against your maneuver save DC. On a failure, until the end of your next turn that creature acts only as you command and takes no action you haven't sanctioned; during that window you may also spend your reaction to compel it to use its own reaction. You must complete a short or long rest before using this feature again.

Influencer (5th level required). Motivating Diplomat's range extends to 15 feet.

Reliable Words (9th level required). Your Charisma (Deception), (Intimidation), and (Persuasion) checks gain a minimum roll threshold, as covered in chapter 7.

Social Opportunist. Any Charisma check you make that wouldn't otherwise include your proficiency bonus gets half that bonus added anyway.

Tyrant's Ferocity. You attack with advantage against any creature that is charmed or frightened by you.
